### anim.datamosh

Transport the previous image with signed motion, selective refresh and optional block holds and recovery.

Origin: toolkit.
Samples the graph clock.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `source` | `raster` | Required | {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |
| Input | `motion` | `any` | `null` |  |
| Input | `confidence` | `any` | `null` |  |
| Input | `valid` | `any` | `null` |  |
| Input | `refresh` | `any` | `null` |  |
| Input | `hold` | `any` | `null` |  |
| Input | `options` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} · {"halfLife":{"type":"number","unit":"seconds","constraints":{"exclusiveMin":0,"max":60},"default":0.45},"velocity":{"type":"vec2","unit":"pixels/second","default":[0,0]},"fieldScale":{"type":"vec2","default":[1,1]},"blockSize":{"type":"vec2","unit":"pixels","description":"Positive whole-pixel width and height up to 4096.","default":[1,1]},"direction":{"type":"string","constraints":{"choices":["current-minus-previous","backward"]},"default":"current-minus-previous"},"units":{"type":"string","constraints":{"choices":["pixels/frame","pixels/second"]},"default":"pixels/frame"},"minConfidence":{"type":"number","constraints":{"min":0,"max":1},"default":0},"filter":{"type":"string","constraints":{"choices":["nearest","linear"]},"default":"nearest"},"blockMemory":{"type":"record","description":"Set a feed rect and optional grouped recovery cadence for block-level hold and refresh."}} |
| Input | `reset` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| Output | `value` | `displayRaster` | — | display byte levels · {"channels":[1,4],"samples":[0,255]} |
| Output | `carry` | `raster` | — | {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |

- Motion vectors are sampled on the current frame grid. Null motion clears history in unheld blocks.
- Confidence is 0–1. Validity, hold and refresh planes use byte coverage units. Hold requires blockMemory.

Guides: [guide](../headless-authoring.md#animation-and-raster-simulation), [guide](../headless-authoring.md#transport-image-history-with-signed-motion), [guide](../render-graph.md#feed-signed-motion), [guide](../render-graph.md#corrupt-one-feed-with-block-memory)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe anim.datamosh --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### anim.frameBank

Keep previous image pixels and refresh selected tiles or masks on independent cadences.

Origin: toolkit.
Samples the graph clock.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `source` | `raster` | Required | {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |
| Input | `masks` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Input | `options` | `record` | Required | {"layout":"Plain named object"} · {"fps":{"type":"number","unit":"frames/second","constraints":{"min":1,"max":120},"default":12},"tiles":{"type":"record","description":"Tile size in pixels with a period, phase and row-major phase step."},"regions":{"type":"array<record>","constraints":{"maxItems":8}},"refresh":{"type":"string","description":"Mask refreshed on each new observed timestamp."},"history":{"type":"number","constraints":{"min":0,"max":512,"integer":true},"description":"Maximum number of retained image observations. Zero disables history.","default":0}} |
| Input | `reset` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| Output | `value` | `displayRaster` | — | display byte levels · {"channels":[1,4],"samples":[0,255]} |
| Output | `refreshed` | `raster` | — | {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |
| Output | `tick` | `frames` | — | frames · {"integer":true,"signed":true} |
| Output | `history` | `any` | — |  |

- Masks are aligned single-channel coverage rasters in [0, 255].
- The bank resets at a cut, a backward seek, a size change, or when reset is true.
- Set history to retain dated images for warp.timeRemap. The grid times the capacity may not exceed 16,000,000 pixels.

Guides: [guide](../headless-authoring.md#per-pixel-time), [guide](../headless-authoring.md#animation-and-raster-simulation), [guide](../headless-authoring.md#selectively-refresh-a-frame-bank)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe anim.frameBank --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.
